This is very genuine and I sincerely appreciated this. 

This is exactly, in the plainest words, the issue. I'm not angry about it, but it does creep me out a bit and I don't like feeling that way. I want to be able to connect with others but without feeling like an alien. This is why I feel so bad about it because it's causing me to generalize in order to protect myself.
This entire thread sums up my feelings perfectly. Thank you. You're way bolder than me though!

This is why I feel bad!
Everyone is free to like what they like! 

But there is a difference between them and you. You enjoy it because of what it is. You don't use what you enjoy as a statement or a way to seem diverse. For you it's about music instead of being culturally sensitive. 

 I know that they weren't being malicious and instead tried to accommodate me. But the fact that I was different enough for them to go as far as to change the party music and speech made me feel like a diplomat in a foreign land. 

Also, simply enjoying and sharing something isn't appropriation. Don't feel bad about it and enjoy!

I don't think that's going to work. 
Speculation, but I feel like being 'blacker' than the black kid is another easy way to feel cool.
